scope.note: Scoped subset per specs/UPSTREAM_BASELINE.md section 5 (HRS-001 scoped run: providers + conformance, 21 test files). The full 5,724-file suite is out of scope for a single classification pass.

reconciliation.arithmetic: counts.by_class sums to totals.classified == totals.collected == len(cases)

class_vocabulary.observable: pass/fail computable from adapter-visible I/O (request kwargs, registry/filesystem state, local fake servers)
class_vocabulary.python-internal: verifies Python process/import/registry-cache semantics with no cross-language observation point
class_vocabulary.platform-host: outcome depends on OS process semantics (SIGKILL, process races, journal-mode resolution) beyond an adapter boundary
class_vocabulary.provider-live: contacts an external provider API without a local fake (none in this subset)
class_vocabulary.explicitly-excluded: excluded from paired runs with a recorded reason (e.g. upstream skip conditions)
